Shouldn’t you spend your time doing what you do best – whether it is selling and marketing, customer service or making decisions on how to grow your business? An entrepreneur tries to juggle many balls each day, but sooner or later, one of them is going to be dropped. As a smart business owner, you will realize that you can’t do everything because there are only 24 hours in a day. Unless you are extremely organized and enjoy working with numbers, then maybe you need to outsource your tax & accounting tasks. LET US HELP WELCOME TO OMNA TAX & ACCOUNTING Omna Tax And accounting Services provides unparalleled personalized accounting services to a broad range of clients across the Edmonton and surrounding areas. As your certified accountants, we are here to ensure that all of your financial decisions are made carefully and with your best interests in mind. We are ready and able to serve as your financial advisor, tax planner, returns and guide along your path to success.  WE WORK WITH ALL ACCOUNTING SOFTWARE Our experienced accountants can work with all accounting software including Quickbooks, Sage, Xero, Stripe, Concur, Avalara, and more!  PERSONALIZED & CUSTOMIZED SOLUTIONS Our professional accountants will work with you to review your business and provide a customized plan that fits your budget and management style.  DEDICATED TO CUSTOMER SERVICES At Omna Tax & Accounting, you’re not just a client. We will be your partner and take care of your paperwork so that you can focus on what you do best. WHAT WE DO OUR SERVICES We’re Dedicated to Providing Personalized And Customized Tax & Accounting Solutions BOOKKEEPING Whether you are big or small, we can assist you in organized financial records to ensure that your business operations will run more efficiently daily and are the foundation of a successful business. We bookkeep for all! Bookkeeping can be a hassle if you don’t do it every day. You have to remember how to log in to your software, how you record certain transactions, and how to reconcile your bank accounts. We remove the hassle. We make it easy for you. Learn More PAYROLL We provide direction and assist with the preparation of regular payroll transactions. We also prepare monthly payroll remittance returns and annual T4, and other government filings. We can also help you implement the controls necessary to ensure a reliable, efficient, and effective payroll system. Learn More BUSINESS SET UP & CONSULTING We assist you with starting a new business, including writing a business plan, selecting a suitable legal structure, registration with taxation authorities, budgeting and cash flow analysis, and obtaining financing. Learn More TAX PREPARATION FOR PERSONAL AND CORPORATE We do T1 personal tax, T2 corporate tax planning. Learn More GST RETURN We can file your GST: Business owners are responsible for collecting and submitting sales taxes in many different jurisdictions. We can help you to minimize tax paying and provide strategies to improve tax issues. Also if you are unsure if you need to register for PST? Contact US! Learn More CRA COMPLIANCE We deal with CRA for any review or audit for individuals, self-employed or corporate clients like GST, Payroll or Corporate Income Tax audits.
